messages.author: e251dfe1bb017bb7
messages.subject: contents of genind @tab slot
parts:
Hi:
1.)  I have been using vcfR to read in a vcf file
2.)Then I created a genind file:  gi.ggcr <- vcfR2genind(ggcr.vcf,sep="[/]",return.alleles=TRUE)
3.)I looked at the structure of gi.ggcr by typing its name and got perfectly reasonable output:
> gi.ggcr
/// GENIND OBJECT /////////

 // 64 individuals; 12,923 loci; 25,846 alleles; size: 14.2 Mb

 // Basic content
   @tab:  64 x 25846 matrix of allele counts
   @loc.n.all: number of alleles per locus (range: 2-2)
   @loc.fac: locus factor for the 25846 columns of @tab
   @all.names: list of allele names for each locus
   @ploidy: ploidy of each individual  (range: 2-2)
   @type:  codom
   @call: adegenet::df2genind(X = t(x), sep = sep)

 // Optional content
   - empty -
 
4.)  Next I wanted to lookat the content of the gi.ggrc@tab slot
Here is where I don't understand something:  the first element of
a row is the ID of the sample.  What do the subsequent numbers mean?
They must have something to do with the various contigs, right.....?

For example: what do the 1s, 2s, and 0s stand for in the following?
gi.ggcr@tab[1:6,11:12]
         dDocent_Contig_28_308.G dDocent_Contig_28_308.A
GGCR_001                       1                       1
GGCR_002                       1                       1
GGCR_003                       1                       1
GGCR_004                       1                       1
GGCR_005                       1                       1
GGCR_006                       1                       1
> gi.ggcr@tab[1:6,13:14]
         dDocent_Contig_31_10.G dDocent_Contig_31_10.T
GGCR_001                      2                      0
GGCR_002                      2                      0
GGCR_003                      2                      0
GGCR_004                      2                      0
GGCR_005                      2                      0
GGCR_006                      2                      0
> gi.ggcr@tab[1:6,15:16]
         dDocent_Contig_31_59.C dDocent_Contig_31_59.T
GGCR_001                      1                      1
GGCR_002                      1                      1
GGCR_003                      1                      1
GGCR_004                      1                      1
GGCR_005                      2                      0
GGCR_006                      1                      1
>
Thanks
Janice Boyd
Texas A&M
